versions.subject: rule: suspicious service binary location
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|contains: 
        - '\$Recycle.bin'
        - '\Users\All Users\'
        - '\Users\Default\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Users\Contacts\'
        - '\Users\Searches\' 
        - 'C:\Perflogs\'
        - '\config\systemprofile\'
        - '\Windows\Fonts\'
        - '\Windows\IME\'
        - '\Windows\addins\'
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\services.exe'
        - '\svchost.exe'
condition: 1 of them
